target: AArch64 PCI QEMU/HVF, disposable VirtIO disk clone
result: pass: exposed bounded absolute PCI VirtIO writes to ZealC; rejected null, negative, zero-count and out-of-range requests; wrote a 256-sector pattern across DMA batches, flushed it, read back every byte, restored the original sectors, and verified the restoration; zstatus failed=0
limits: The probe only writes to the harness's copy-on-write QEMU disk clone. The new ZcRawDiskWrite bridge is a low-level absolute PCI VirtIO primitive; it does not register a stock CDrive/CBlkDev, provide mounted filesystem write semantics, enable Pi SDHCI writes, or validate a physical target.
